published.source: DPS report 2026-10-31 (wowsimcli on this request, 20,000 iterations, seed 1, 180 ± 20 s; re-simmed on 2026-10-30 or 2026-10-31)

summary: Deep Elemental with a staff, built on Lava Burst and Elemental Mastery.
rotation: Pre-pull: Lightning Shield at -5.4s, Mana Spring Totem at -3.9s, Lightning Bolt at -2.9s (lands 0.1s after the pull), Searing Totem at -0.9s
Elemental Mastery and other cooldowns (Sapper, Demonic Rune, Caustic Smog Potion) when ready
Mana Spring Totem when it is down, with at least 20s left
Searing Totem when it is down, with at least 20s left
Flame Shock when its DoT is down, with at least 9s left
Lava Burst on cooldown, unless Flame Shock would run out before the cast ends
Earth Shock when a Lightning Bolt would not land before the end
Lightning Shield when it is down, above 50% mana with at least 60s left. Its orbs fire at the boss when the shaman takes a hit, about 2 a minute.
Lightning Bolt rank 8 once mana won't last the fight at 30 mana a second. Under Clearcasting, the top rank, since it's free.
Lightning Bolt rank 10 as filler. No Chain Lightning on one target.
caveats: Lightning Bolt X's base damage is ×1.12. The beta raised the top playable rank by that much.
Only the Tier 1 2-piece is active. The 5-piece (Lava Burst -1s cooldown) would add more.
Only one 2% crit elixir. Owl on top of Sages would add about 10 DPS.
Elemental Focus procs less often on low ranks since 7 Oct. By how much is unknown.
The sim doesn't check that Searing Totem reaches the boss from range.
Assumed: the shaman takes 2 damage hits a minute. Each one fires Lightning Shield.
Eye of the Storm 3 stops 70% of the pushback from the 2 hits a minute.
notes: mksettings -spec ele -apl level60 (standards 23: every shaman drops its own party totems; the raid has none, the shaman drops Mana Spring Totem itself); race SkyborneWindshaper (the best race since client 70425's Wind Blessed 3% haste). The raid's Sunder Armor ramps since 2026-10-31 (standard 32, mksettings -sunder ramp): a warrior tank stacks it from the pull and one DPS warrior casts it on its first GCD.
